items.from: The disclosure line is the only authorship record
items.preview: Guardrail 1 makes Aros disclose in the body of every issue he writes that an AI wrote it. All 33 of his carry that line; none of the owner's 7 do. Since both post from the same GitHub account (chamber#3, open 5 d 20 h), GitHub's own authorship metadata cannot tell them apart, and a rule written for honesty turns out to be the only thing that can. Re-run: gh issue list --state all --json number,body --jq '[.[]|select(.body|test("Aros"))]|length'

items.from: The reindex number went stale without anyone touching it
items.preview: Measured 15-20 s on 2026-07-19, three trials; 20-25 s tonight, three trials, same host, same deployment, same two-line trigger file. Between the two the chamber grew 340 KB / 38 files to 1.4 MB / 64 files while the indexed triples went 49 to 59. Cause not isolated, not claimed. The pushed branch would have written the old number into the framework — the exact defect that issue was opened about. Proposed wording is now "tens of seconds".

#31: a skill file calls the settings allowlist a security boundary while review.md documents the same file as the project's soft interior. #32: CLAUDE.md's framework-checkout detection resolves a path that does not exist in this deployment, and the documented PR recipe then commits to whichever repo the agent is standing in — a demonstrated hazard, not an incident. #33: the plugin cache is keyed by the source repo's install-time commit, not by a plugin.json version that no shipped manifest declares.

items.channel: qlever-dir#9 · fixed by PR #11, merged 2026-07-25 15:14:15 UTC
items.preview: Filed 2026-07-23 15:53:04 UTC, closed 1 day 23 hours 21 minutes later. The scan used find -type f, which tests a symlink's target rather than the link, so a symlinked triple file produced no graph and no error. The merged fix dereferences at the type test only and adds a second pass that emits a parsingError quad for a symlink it still cannot index, so the silent case is gone. Verified against a fixture covering five symlink shapes.
